caption: San Giorgio Maggiore, Venice
composition: Palladian white stone church and brick campanile across the Bacino · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the water, the tourist faces the island of San Giorgio Maggiore across the Bacino, the white Palladian church front centered with its classical portico. The tall brick campanile with its white spire rises to the right above the red-brick monastery blocks, with trees along the waterfront. The 12:20 midday sun is bright under a pale blue sky, and the lagoon stretches calm and blue in the foreground.
